cues.en: This is the Global News podcast from the BBC World Service.
cues.zh: 这里是 BBC 世界服务的《全球新闻》播客。

cues.en: I'm Alex Ritson, and in the early hours of Wednesday the 23rd of September, these are our main stories.
cues.zh: 我是亚历克斯·里特森。9月23日星期三凌晨，以下是我们的主要新闻。

cues.en: Donald Trump hails what he calls a productive meeting with Iranian officials on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly.
cues.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普称，他在联合国大会期间与伊朗官员举行了富有成效的会晤。

cues.en: An organised crime group shuts down parts of Colombia's Caribbean coast, prompting the president to send in the army.
cues.zh: 一个有组织犯罪团伙让哥伦比亚加勒比海沿岸部分地区停摆，总统因此派军队进入。

cues.en: Also in this podcast, how an entrepreneur in Ghana turns waste plastic packaging into school desks.
cues.zh: 本期还将介绍加纳一名创业者如何把废弃塑料包装变成课桌。

cues.en: And the longer this book is on sale, the more egregious the damage from the defamation becomes.
cues.zh: 而这本书销售得越久，诽谤造成的损害就越严重。

cues.en: A call for Earl Spencer's book about Princess Diana to be pulped because of a factual error.
cues.zh: 有人呼吁将厄尔·斯宾塞关于戴安娜王妃的书下架销毁，因为书中有事实错误。

cues.en: The war in Iran was always going to dominate this year's United Nations General Assembly.
cues.zh: 伊朗战争注定会成为今年联合国大会的主导议题。

cues.en: The annual gathering of leaders and officials from around the world is an opportunity for diplomacy.
cues.zh: 世界各地领导人和官员每年齐聚于此，为外交提供了机会。

cues.en: On Tuesday there were direct talks between the US and Iran for the first time in months.
cues.zh: 周二，美国和伊朗数月来首次举行了直接会谈。

cues.en: But it's also an occasion for fiery speeches and rhetoric, and when President Trump addressed the assembly, he included a threat of extreme action against Iran.
cues.zh: 但大会也常有激烈演讲和言辞；特朗普总统向大会发言时，威胁要对伊朗采取极端行动。

cues.en: I have a big decision to make.
cues.zh: 我有一个重大决定要作。

cues.en: Will a deal be made with Iran that lets them rebuild and create a far greater country than it ever was before, maybe one of the greatest in the Middle East or even the world?
cues.zh: 是否能与伊朗达成协议，让它重建，成为比以往强大得多的国家，或许成为中东乃至世界上最强大的国家之一？

cues.en: Or do I annihilate the Islamic Republic and do it quickly, never giving them a chance to kill and destroy people and countries again?
cues.zh: 还是要迅速摧毁伊斯兰共和国，绝不给它再次杀戮、摧毁人民和国家的机会？

cues.en: Do I drive them into hell with no chance of survival and no hope of future greatness or generations?
cues.zh: 我要把他们赶入地狱，让他们没有生存机会，也没有未来或后代兴盛的希望吗？

cues.en: But I believe we'll make a deal right after the election.
cues.zh: 但我相信，我们会在选举后立即达成协议。

cues.en: Meanwhile, at the General Assembly, Trump's chief envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner spent three hours talking with Iran's foreign minister Abbas Araghchi.
cues.zh: 与此同时，在联合国大会期间，特朗普的首席特使史蒂夫·威特科夫和贾里德·库什纳与伊朗外长阿巴斯·阿拉格齐会谈了三小时。

cues.en: Mr. Trump said the talks were productive. Iranian state media said their main purpose was to convey Tehran's conditions for reopening the Strait of Hormuz.
cues.zh: 特朗普称会谈富有成效。伊朗国家媒体则称，会谈主要是为了传达德黑兰重开霍尔木兹海峡的条件。

cues.en: I asked our State Department correspondent Tom Bateman what else had come out of that meeting.
cues.zh: 我询问了本台国务院记者汤姆·贝特曼，了解那次会晤还有哪些结果。

cues.en: It was a three-hour meeting, so clearly it covered a lot of ground.
cues.zh: 这是一次三小时的会晤，显然谈及了许多内容。

cues.en: I think it is almost certain that the fate of the Strait of Hormuz was a key part of that.
cues.zh: 我认为，霍尔木兹海峡的前途几乎肯定是其中的关键议题。

cues.en: Now there is a sense from at least one Iranian official of a preparedness to lower the demands on the Iranian side with the Americans.
cues.zh: 现在，至少有一名伊朗官员释放出信号，称伊朗方面准备降低对美国的要求。

cues.en: That may be a result of the punishing economic blockade that the Americans have in place, which is continuing to put massive pressure on the regime.
cues.zh: 这可能是美国实施严厉经济封锁的结果；封锁仍在持续给伊朗政权施加巨大压力。

cues.en: This Iranian official says they would be prepared to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within a week
cues.zh: 这名伊朗官员表示，他们准备在一周内重开霍尔木兹海峡。

cues.en: if the Americans remove their naval blockade of Iranian ports plus some other measures.
cues.zh: 前提是美国解除对伊朗港口的海上封锁，并采取其他措施。

cues.en: But these are not the same extensive list of demands that the Iranians had previously in order to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.
cues.zh: 但这并不是伊朗此前为重开霍尔木兹海峡提出的那份长长要求清单。

cues.en: So there is a feeling of potential progress, although Donald Trump seems to be foreclosing the idea
cues.zh: 因此，人们感觉事情可能取得进展，不过特朗普似乎排除了这种可能。

cues.en: that there won't be a deal before the US midterm elections, which aren't until early November.
cues.zh: 这种可能就是美国中期选举前不会达成协议，而选举要到11月初才举行。

cues.en: Having said that, I was standing outside the UN building when Steve Witkoff walked out wearing sunglasses.
cues.zh: 话虽如此，我当时站在联合国大楼外，史蒂夫·威特科夫戴着太阳镜走了出来。

cues.en: My colleague Neda Torfik shouted to ask how the meeting with the Iranians had gone.
cues.zh: 我的同事内达·托菲克喊住他，询问与伊朗人的会晤进展如何。

cues.en: He gave us a big thumbs up, and he has certainly been briefing out that in his view the meeting went very well.
cues.zh: 他向我们竖起大拇指，也一直对外宣称，在他看来会晤进展得非常顺利。

cues.en: He does tend to put a positive spin on things, even if that isn't absolutely the case.
cues.zh: 即使事实并非完全如此，他也确实倾向于把事情说得很乐观。

cues.en: This meeting is significant because there hasn't been a meeting at that level between the Iranians and Americans since about June.
cues.zh: 这次会晤意义重大，因为美伊双方自6月左右以来就没有举行过这一层级的会晤。

cues.en: That was when Vice President JD Vance was meeting the Iranians in Pakistan.
cues.zh: 当时是副总统 J.D.万斯在巴基斯坦与伊朗人会面。

cues.en: So perhaps it looks like a potential for dialogue is back open.
cues.zh: 所以，看来对话的可能性似乎重新开启了。

cues.en: But we have been here many times before, where it has felt like the potential for progress is there and it simply hasn't materialized.
cues.zh: 但我们以前多次经历过这种情况：进展似乎触手可及，最终却根本没有实现。

cues.en: And on the other hand, you have Mr. Trump repeating the threat to annihilate, quote, and drive Iran into hell.
cues.zh: 另一方面，特朗普再次重复了要“摧毁”伊朗、把它赶入地狱的威胁。

cues.en: Now he's made those threats on social media and in the Oval Office. Here he's doing it in front of more than 190 countries.
cues.zh: 此前他在社交媒体和椭圆形办公室发出过这些威胁，而这一次是在190多个国家面前。

cues.en: At the body meant to seek peace and security through dialogue and diplomacy.
cues.zh: 地点是在这个本应通过对话与外交寻求和平与安全的组织。

cues.en: So it tells you something about where we are and also, frankly, how kind of normalized some of these threats have become now.
cues.zh: 这说明了我们所处的局面，也坦率地说，说明其中一些威胁如今已经在某种程度上被常态化了。

cues.en: But having said all that, it does feel like potentially the door opening on some diplomacy again.
cues.zh: 不过话虽如此，外交之门似乎确实有可能再次打开。

cues.en: Mr. Trump also held talks with President Zelensky on the sidelines of the United Nations General Assembly.
cues.zh: 特朗普还在联合国大会期间与泽连斯基总统举行了会谈。

cues.en: Do we know what they discussed, how the Ukraine war is playing into Donald Trump's thoughts?
cues.zh: 我们知道他们讨论了什么吗？乌克兰战争如何影响唐纳德·特朗普的想法？

cues.en: Well, I think it's almost certain that President Trump will have repeated his strong desire.
cues.zh: 我认为，特朗普总统几乎肯定会再次强调他的强烈愿望。

cues.en: That Ukrainian long-range drone and missile strikes against Russian energy facilities are brought to an end.
cues.zh: 他希望乌克兰对俄罗斯能源设施发动的远程无人机和导弹袭击停止。

cues.en: But the framework for that is now accepted to have to be some kind of arrangement or agreement between the Russians and the Ukrainians.
cues.zh: 但现在普遍认为，实现这一点必须依靠俄乌之间某种安排或协议。

cues.en: You know, Mr. Trump had said a couple of weeks ago.
cues.zh: 你知道，特朗普几周前曾说过。

cues.en: That Russia and Ukraine had reached an agreement on not striking each other's energy targets.
cues.zh: 俄罗斯和乌克兰已经达成协议，不攻击对方的能源目标。

cues.en: That just simply did not materialize. It just wasn't the case.
cues.zh: 但这根本没有实现，事实并非如此。

cues.en: But there's obviously pressure from the Americans, because Ukraine's been hitting energy targets.
cues.zh: 但显然美国方面施加了压力，因为乌克兰一直在打击能源目标。

cues.en: The Russians have been firing, as ever, at both civilian and energy targets and the power grid in Ukraine.
cues.zh: 而俄罗斯一如既往地向乌克兰的民用目标、能源目标和电网开火。

cues.en: The reason Mr. Trump is particularly concerned at the moment is because Russia has for some time stopped exporting diesel.
cues.zh: 特朗普目前尤其担心，是因为俄罗斯已经停止出口柴油一段时间了。

cues.en: It's the second-biggest exporter in the world after the United States.
cues.zh: 俄罗斯是仅次于美国的全球第二大柴油出口国。

cues.en: The cost of diesel here in the US is at record levels.
cues.zh: 美国的柴油价格目前处于创纪录水平。

cues.en: That's affecting the haulage industry and farming, and that is a political nightmare for Mr. Trump.
cues.zh: 这影响了运输业和农业，对特朗普来说是一场政治噩梦。

cues.en: Because it's simply making worse this cost-of-living issue for Americans.
cues.zh: 因为这只会让美国人的生活成本问题更加严重。

cues.en: Which, according to the polling, his party stands set to be punished for at the coming midterm elections in November.
cues.zh: 根据民调，这个问题可能让他的政党在即将到来的11月中期选举中受到惩罚。

cues.en: So that is a key political priority for Mr. Trump.
cues.zh: 所以，这是特朗普的一项关键政治优先事项。

cues.en: And beyond the ongoing aspiration to get an end to the war between Russia and Ukraine.
cues.zh: 除了持续努力结束俄乌战争之外，

cues.en: Stopping those strikes will have been a key part of those discussions.
cues.zh: 停止这些袭击也将是会谈的重要内容。

cues.en: Our State Department correspondent Tom Bateman.
cues.zh: 本台国务院记者汤姆·贝特曼的报道。

cues.en: Sri Lanka's High Court has given long prison sentences to 15 men charged with plotting the Easter Sunday bomb attacks in 2019.
cues.zh: 斯里兰卡高等法院判处15名男子长期监禁，他们被控策划2019年复活节星期日爆炸案。

cues.en: The coordinated blasts at churches and luxury hotels killed 270 people and injured more than 500.
cues.zh: 教堂和豪华酒店发生的连环爆炸造成270人死亡、500多人受伤。

cues.en: Our global affairs correspondent Anbarasan Ethirajan told Valerie Sanderson what happened on the day of the attack.
cues.zh: 我们的全球事务记者安巴拉桑·埃蒂拉詹向瓦莱丽·桑德森讲述袭击当天的情况。

cues.en: These nine suicide bombers belonged to one of the homegrown Islamist groups. They carried out these attacks.
cues.zh: 这9名自杀式炸弹袭击者属于一个本土伊斯兰主义组织，他们实施了这些袭击。

cues.en: So there was a sense of shock and disbelief in Sri Lanka because this was after the end of the civil war
cues.zh: 斯里兰卡民众感到震惊和难以置信，因为内战结束后，

cues.en: when Sri Lanka was more peaceful and it became one of the popular tourist destinations.
cues.zh: 斯里兰卡更加和平，也成了热门旅游目的地之一。

cues.en: All of a sudden this attack happened. It was well coordinated and well planned.
cues.zh: 袭击突然发生了，而且组织严密、计划周详。

cues.en: Because they were targeting foreigners in these five-star hotels.
cues.zh: 因为袭击者的目标是这些五星级酒店里的外国人。

cues.en: And also the Sunday mass was going on, Easter Sunday mass, and that is when they targeted these worshippers.
cues.zh: 当时复活节星期日弥撒正在举行，袭击者就在那时向礼拜者下手。

cues.en: And 45 foreigners were among those killed.
cues.zh: 死者中有45名外国人。

cues.en: And then the government went after these groupings.
cues.zh: 随后政府开始追查这些团体。

cues.en: In fact, the then president Maithripala Sirisena was accused of a security lapse. They did not follow up on intelligence provided by India.
cues.zh: 事实上，时任总统迈特里帕拉·西里塞纳被指疏于安保；当局没有跟进印度提供的情报。

cues.en: In fact, two senior officials were sentenced to death for criminal negligence last month.
cues.zh: 事实上，两名高级官员上月因刑事疏忽被判处死刑。

cues.en: Now here comes this verdict. This is the first direct court case involving those accused of supporting this Islamist group.
cues.zh: 现在判决下来了。这是首宗直接审理支持该伊斯兰主义组织者的案件。

cues.en: And tell us more about the men who've been convicted.
cues.zh: 请介绍一下被定罪的这些人。

cues.en: Now one of the main persons here is Naufer Moulavi. The prosecutors accused him of being the ringleader of this group
cues.zh: 其中一名主要人物是瑙费尔·毛拉维。检方指控他是该组织的头目，

cues.en: and he was also charged with providing support to these suicide bombers who carried out these attacks.
cues.zh: 他还被控向实施袭击的自杀式炸弹袭击者提供支持。

cues.en: And nine were found not guilty, they were released and one person died in custody.
cues.zh: 9人被判无罪并获释，另有1人在羁押期间死亡。

cues.en: Of course, during the trial process, all of them denied any involvement.
cues.zh: 当然，审理期间他们都否认参与其中。

cues.en: But they belonged to Sri Lanka's minority Muslim community, and the community was under intense scrutiny.
cues.zh: 但他们属于斯里兰卡少数族裔穆斯林社群，该社群受到严密审视。

cues.en: There were also lots of hate attacks after this incident happened.
cues.zh: 事件发生后还出现了许多仇恨袭击。

cues.en: But it also put the highlights on how far the Sri Lankan intelligence was prepared to listen to the warnings that these attacks could happen.
cues.zh: 这也凸显出，斯里兰卡情报部门对可能发生袭击的警告究竟准备听取到什么程度。

cues.en: Is it admitted now it was a big lapse?
cues.zh: 现在是否承认这是一次严重疏忽？

cues.en: They did admit, and that is why two of the senior officials
cues.zh: 他们确实承认了，因此两名高级官员，

cues.en: one was the former police chief and another was the defense secretary, were found guilty of criminal negligence
cues.zh: 一人是前警察总长，另一人是国防秘书，两人被判犯有刑事疏忽，

cues.en: and that's why they were given the death sentence. Ethirajan.
cues.zh: 因此被判处死刑。埃蒂拉詹。

cues.en: The British broadcaster Piers Morgan has called for a newly released book by Earl Spencer about Princess Diana
cues.zh: 英国广播人皮尔斯·摩根呼吁将厄尔·斯宾塞关于戴安娜王妃的新书，

cues.en: to be pulled from the shelves because of a factual error.
cues.zh: 因书中有事实错误而下架。

cues.en: Earl Spencer, who's Diana's brother, has apologised to Mr Morgan after wrongly describing him in the book as being editor of a British tabloid
cues.zh: 戴安娜的弟弟厄尔·斯宾塞向摩根道歉，因为他在书中错误地称摩根是英国小报的编辑，

cues.en: when it published covert photos of Diana in the gym in 1993.
cues.zh: 而该报曾在1993年刊登戴安娜在健身房锻炼的偷拍照片。

cues.en: Mr Morgan has threatened to sue for what he called fabricated inaccuracies.
cues.zh: 摩根威胁要就他所谓的捏造性不实内容提起诉讼。

cues.en: Our royal correspondent Sean Coughlan reports.
cues.zh: 我们的王室记者肖恩·考夫兰报道。

cues.en: Earl Spencer's controversial memoir has created some awkward headlines for the royal family.
cues.zh: 厄尔·斯宾塞这本有争议的回忆录给王室制造了一些尴尬头条。

cues.en: And on a visit, Prince William had to brush past questions.
cues.zh: 访问期间，威廉王子不得不避开相关提问。

cues.en: So how do you feel about your uncle's book? Have you read it? We love you.
cues.zh: 你怎么看你叔叔的书？你读过吗？我们爱你。

cues.en: But it was the author Earl Spencer who has faced more awkward questions as he's had to make an embarrassing apology to Piers Morgan
cues.zh: 但作者厄尔·斯宾塞面临了更多尴尬提问，因为他不得不向皮尔斯·摩根作出难堪的道歉，

cues.en: for a factual error in the book.
cues.zh: 为书中的事实错误致歉。

cues.en: In his account, Earl Spencer describes how he personally rang tabloid newspaper editors to withdraw the invitations to Diana's funeral in 1997.
cues.zh: 厄尔·斯宾塞在书中写道，1997年他亲自致电小报编辑，要求撤回参加戴安娜葬礼的邀请。

cues.en: This included Piers Morgan, who the book blames for a Mirror newspaper story
cues.zh: 这其中包括皮尔斯·摩根，书中指责他要为《镜报》的一篇报道负责，

cues.en: that intruded on Diana's privacy with pictures of her exercising in a gym.
cues.zh: 该报道刊登戴安娜在健身房锻炼的照片，侵犯了她的隐私。

cues.en: Except that Piers Morgan wasn't the paper's editor at the time
cues.zh: 但当时皮尔斯·摩根并不是该报的编辑，

cues.en: and he's calling for the publication to be stopped.
cues.zh: 他因此呼吁停止出版这本书。

cues.en: He's apologised this afternoon for getting it completely wrong.
cues.zh: 厄尔·斯宾塞当天午后道歉，承认自己完全弄错了。

cues.en: The Earl describes himself as a historian and says it's his duty to correct the record.
cues.zh: 厄尔称自己是历史学家，并表示有责任纠正记录。

cues.en: Well, in that case, I am asking for the book to be withdrawn.
cues.zh: 那么，在这种情况下，我要求撤回这本书。

cues.en: In a statement, the Earl said his account of his conversation with Mr Morgan
cues.zh: 厄尔在声明中说，他对与摩根谈话的叙述，

cues.en: was accurate, but he wished to apologise
cues.zh: 内容准确，但他仍希望道歉，

cues.en: that his assumption concerning his role at the Mirror was wrong.
cues.zh: 因为他对摩根在《镜报》所任职务的判断是错误的。

cues.en: It's understood the publishers Penguin are planning to make a correction in future editions. Sean Coughlan.
cues.zh: 据悉，出版商企鹅兰登计划在未来版本中更正这一错误。肖恩·考夫兰。

cues.en: Still to come in this podcast,
cues.zh: 本期节目稍后将介绍，

cues.en: the six-year-old who solved the Rubik's Cube in barely four seconds.
cues.zh: 一名六岁儿童：他用不到四秒就还原了魔方。

cues.en: This is the Global News podcast.
cues.zh: 这里是《全球新闻》播客。

cues.en: To Colombia now, where videos circulating online have shown
cues.zh: 现在来看哥伦比亚：网上流传的视频显示，

cues.en: armed men on motorcycles setting fire to trucks in the northern city of Santa Marta.
cues.zh: 武装人员骑着摩托车，在北部城市圣玛尔塔焚烧卡车。

cues.en: They're said to be members of a group calling itself the ACSN
cues.zh: 据称他们是一个自称 ACSN 的组织成员，

cues.en: or the Conquering Self-Defense Forces of Sierra Nevada, which controls cocaine trafficking routes.
cues.zh: 该组织名为内华达山征服自卫军，控制着可卡因贩运路线。

cues.en: In response, the Colombian president Abelardo de la Espriella has sent troops to the city.
cues.zh: 作为回应，哥伦比亚总统阿韦拉多·德拉埃斯普列亚已向该市派兵。

cues.en: We're going to fortify Santa Marta and defend it to show the bandits that when the state is determined, it never loses.
cues.zh: 我们将巩固并保卫圣玛尔塔，向匪徒表明，只要国家坚定，就绝不会失败。

cues.en: Any bandit who refuses to surrender will be neutralized as the law requires.
cues.zh: 任何拒绝投降的匪徒，都将依法被制服。

cues.en: We stand firm for our country.
cues.zh: 我们坚定捍卫国家。

cues.en: Our Latin America expert from BBC Monitoring, Luis Fajardo, told me more about what happened in Santa Marta.
cues.zh: BBC Monitoring 的拉丁美洲事务专家路易斯·法哈多向我进一步介绍了圣玛尔塔的情况。

cues.en: Alex, these are really disturbing images for many Colombians who have been seeing these things happening in Santa Marta,
cues.zh: 亚历克斯，对许多哥伦比亚人来说，这些画面令人不安；他们一直看到圣玛尔塔发生这样的事情，

cues.en: which is a fairly important tourist resort and a provincial capital.
cues.zh: 那里是一个相当重要的旅游胜地，也是省会。

cues.en: So not in the periphery, but a rather important city in Colombia,
cues.zh: 所以这不是边远地区，而是哥伦比亚一座相当重要的城市，

cues.en: they have seen scenes of violence and intimidation throughout the day.
cues.zh: 人们一整天都在目睹暴力和恐吓场面。

cues.en: This criminal group announced what it called a "paro armado," armed strike,
cues.zh: 这个犯罪团体宣布了他们所谓的“paro armado”，即武装罢工，

cues.en: which meant that they were basically ordering the city to shut down.
cues.zh: 意思是他们基本上是在命令这座城市停摆。

cues.en: They were intimidating people in little shops, in buses.
cues.zh: 他们在小商店和公交车上恐吓民众。

cues.en: They have burned a few vehicles and they have threatened people with violence
cues.zh: 他们烧毁了几辆车，并以暴力威胁民众，

cues.en: if they did not accept their order to basically disrupt activities in the city.
cues.zh: 如果民众不接受他们的命令，他们就要扰乱城市活动。

cues.en: This was a result of the killing of a couple of leaders of this criminal organization.
cues.zh: 这起事件源于该犯罪组织几名领导人被杀。

cues.en: So, a substantial spike of violence in this city, and as the new government of
cues.zh: 因此，这座城市的暴力事件大幅增加；新政府也

cues.en: Abelardo de la Espriella has promised to intensify the combat against these illegal armed groups.
cues.zh: 而且阿韦拉多·德拉埃斯普列亚政府已承诺加强打击这些非法武装团体。

cues.en: What do we know about this group and its aims?
cues.zh: 关于这个团体及其目标，我们知道些什么？

cues.en: The so-called Conquistadores de la Sierra, Conquerors of the Sierra, operates as a regional criminal gang.
cues.zh: 所谓的“山地征服者”，即内华达山征服者，是一个地区性犯罪团伙。

cues.en: It is not the most powerful criminal organization in Colombia.
cues.zh: 它不是哥伦比亚最强大的犯罪组织。

cues.en: It is one of many criminal groups that have organized regional control in many parts of the country, using their armed force,
cues.zh: 它是众多犯罪团体之一，这些团体在全国许多地区组织起地方控制，凭借武力，

cues.en: their intimidation methods to advance in their illegal businesses, in this case, drug trafficking.
cues.zh: 利用恐吓手段推进非法生意，在这里就是贩毒。

cues.en: So again, not the most powerful of the criminal gangs, but certainly a gang that has been
cues.zh: 所以再说一遍，它不是最强大的犯罪团伙，但确实一直是一个

cues.en: very influential gang in this area in Santa Marta, also near the Venezuelan border in the northeastern part of the country.
cues.zh: 在圣玛尔塔这一地区颇具影响力的团伙，也靠近该国东北部的委内瑞拉边境。

cues.en: And they have been active, and the government has launched several attacks against them, which they are now retaliating against.
cues.zh: 他们一直很活跃，政府也对其发动过数次攻击，如今他们正在进行报复。

cues.en: And this despite there being a new right-wing president in charge who is a friend of Donald Trump.
cues.zh: 尽管目前执政的是一位与唐纳德·特朗普友好的右翼总统。

cues.en: Yes, certainly Abelardo de la Espriella, who became Colombian president on the 7th of August,
cues.zh: 是的，阿韦拉多·德拉埃斯普列亚于8月7日就任哥伦比亚总统，

cues.en: he is replacing a left-wing administration which had tried to conduct peace talks with many of these criminal organizations.
cues.zh: 他取代了曾试图与许多犯罪组织进行和平谈判的左翼政府。

cues.en: De la Espriella instead, he calls himself the Tiger, and he has promised a very strong military crackdown.
cues.zh: 而德拉埃斯普列亚自称“老虎”，并承诺进行强力军事镇压。

cues.en: He has, the armed forces have indeed started killing several of the leaders of this and many other organizations.
cues.zh: 他已经——武装部队确实开始杀死该组织及其他许多组织的几名领导人。

cues.en: But what has happened in Santa Marta in the last few hours makes it clear that these groups
cues.zh: 但从过去几小时圣玛尔塔发生的这些行动可以清楚看出，这些团体

cues.en: remain powerful and they remain capable of disrupting activities
cues.zh: 仍然势力强大，仍有能力扰乱活动。

cues.en: in large parts of Colombia. Luis Fajardo from BBC Monitoring.
cues.zh: 在哥伦比亚大片地区制造混乱。BBC Monitoring 的路易斯·法哈多报道。

cues.en: El Niño in the Pacific is still a few weeks from its peak, but it's already breaking records, with impacts likely around the world.
cues.zh: 太平洋的厄尔尼诺天气模式距离峰值还有几周，但它已经打破纪录，可能给世界各地带来深远影响。

cues.en: The UK's Met Office says it's now the strongest event in the observational record.
cues.zh: 英国气象局说，这是有观测记录以来最强的一次厄尔尼诺事件。

cues.en: Here's our environment correspondent, Matt McGrath.
cues.zh: 下面请听本台环境事务记者马特·麦格拉思的报道。

cues.en: An El Niño begins when waters in the central Pacific rise about half a degree above the long-term average
cues.zh: 衡量厄尔尼诺的方法是：太平洋中部海水温度一旦比长期平均值高出约半摄氏度，

cues.en: that's the start of an El Niño.
cues.zh: 就标志着厄尔尼诺开始了。

cues.en: Above one degree, it enters more serious territory.
cues.zh: 一旦超过一度，就开始进入更严重的阶段。

cues.en: Above two degrees, then it's called a very strong El Niño.
cues.zh: 超过两度，就被称为非常强的厄尔尼诺。

cues.en: Now we had the two-degree mark go past a few months ago.
cues.zh: 几个月前，温度已经超过了两度这个关口。

cues.en: It's been a strong El Niño for the last couple of months.
cues.zh: 过去几个月一直是强厄尔尼诺。

cues.en: The latest data show that it's around three degrees warmer than the long-term average.
cues.zh: 最新数据显示，温度比长期平均值高出约三度。

cues.en: But how much precisely it is above the long-term average, we're not quite sure as yet.
cues.zh: 但究竟高出长期平均值多少，目前还不完全确定。

cues.en: The fear, I guess, from scientists is that this will continue, with projections showing it somewhere between three and four degrees above average.
cues.zh: 科学家担心这种趋势会继续，预测显示温度可能比平均值高出三到四度。

cues.en: That's a phenomenal amount of heat and impact on the world. We've never seen anything like it.
cues.zh: 这将是极其巨大的热量，也会对世界产生惊人的影响。我们以前从未真正见过这样的情况。

cues.en: We're still not sure what the impacts will be across the world.
cues.zh: 至于它将在世界各地造成什么影响，我们仍不确定。

cues.en: We can already see some signals, but it'll be later this year
cues.zh: 我们显然已经看到了一些迹象，但要到今年晚些时候，

cues.en: especially by the middle of next year, when the heat's impact will be clearer.
cues.zh: 尤其是明年年中，才能更清楚地看到这些热量的影响。

cues.en: We're already seeing in some places in the monsoon areas perhaps less rain than normal.
cues.zh: 在一些季风地区，我们已经看到降雨可能少于正常水平。

cues.en: In other places, in parts of California, they're preparing for greater deluges.
cues.zh: 而在加利福尼亚部分地区，人们正准备应对更大的暴雨。

cues.en: We're likely to see greater floods and downpours.
cues.zh: 我们很可能会看到更严重的洪水和暴雨。

cues.en: We're seeing the Panama Canal not at its peak or restricting traffic because of lower water levels.
cues.zh: 由于水位降低，巴拿马运河水位尚未达到峰值，或正在限制通行。

cues.en: So all around the world there'll be different impacts: impacts on food production, impacts on droughts, on heat and on floods.
cues.zh: 因此，世界各地将受到不同影响：粮食生产、干旱、高温和洪水都会受到波及。

cues.en: By the middle of next year, we'll probably see the bigger impact on overall global temperatures, which are expected to break records by some distance.
cues.zh: 但到明年年中，更大的影响可能会体现在全球整体气温上，预计气温将大幅打破纪录。

cues.en: Matt McGrath.
cues.zh: 马特·麦格拉思报道。

cues.en: Now to Ghana, where an entrepreneur has worked out a way to solve two problems at once by turning waste plastic packaging into school desks.
cues.zh: 下面来到加纳。一名企业家找到了一举解决两个问题的方法，把废弃塑料包装制成学校课桌。

cues.en: Our reporter, Justice Baidu.
cues.zh: 本台记者贾斯蒂斯·拜杜报道。

cues.en: Justice Baidu met Makafui Awuku in his workshop in the capital city, Accra.
cues.zh: 贾斯蒂斯·拜杜在首都阿克拉的工作坊采访了马卡富伊·阿乌库。

cues.en: Well, so this is Makintouch Africa. Welcome to Makintouch Africa. So let's walk around and let me show you some of them.
cues.zh: 这里就是 Makintouch Africa。欢迎来到这里。我们四处看看，我给你介绍其中一些。

cues.en: Yeah. Makafui Awuku, big and smiling, has an infectious passion for recycling plastic. He shows me his current stockpile.
cues.zh: 好的。马卡富伊·阿乌库身材高大、笑容灿烂，对塑料回收有着感染力十足的热情。他向我展示了目前的库存。

cues.en: So it's a huge heap of plastic bottles, sachet wrappers, that have been collected together.
cues.zh: 这里是一大堆收集起来的塑料瓶和塑料袋包装。

cues.en: How much plastic do we have here?
cues.zh: 这里有多少塑料？

cues.en: So what you see here looks like about 400 kilograms.
cues.zh: 你看到的这些大约有400公斤。

cues.en: Wow, that's a lot. We generate about 1.1 million metric tons of plastic waste in Ghana every year.
cues.zh: 哇，真不少。加纳每年产生约110万吨塑料垃圾。

cues.en: In Ghana, it is thought that just around 5% of plastic is collected for recycling.
cues.zh: 据认为，加纳只有约5%的塑料被收集起来回收。

cues.en: Makafui's latest project addresses another problem here in Ghana: a shortage of school desks.
cues.zh: 马卡富伊的最新项目还解决了加纳的另一个问题：学校课桌短缺。

cues.en: We have a lot of desk deficits in our schools.
cues.zh: 我们的学校严重缺少课桌。

cues.en: We have a desk deficit of close to 2 million.
cues.zh: 我们缺少近200万张课桌。

cues.en: Makafui makes desk tops from the plastic sachets that are commonly used for drinking water here in Ghana.
cues.zh: 马卡富伊用加纳常见的饮水塑料袋制作课桌桌面。

cues.en: He has 300 drop-off points for the sachets around the country.
cues.zh: 他在全国设有300个塑料袋回收点。

cues.en: And he supplements these by buying more that have been gathered by waste pickers.
cues.zh: 此外，他还购买拾荒者收集的塑料袋作为补充。

cues.en: So when the dry shreds come here, we have this heat-transfer equipment
cues.zh: 干燥的碎料送到这里后，我们用这套热转印设备，

cues.en: and then we have a hydraulic press that we use to press it.
cues.zh: 然后用液压机把它们压制成型。

cues.en: Okay, so we set it and then we wait.
cues.zh: 好，我们把它设定好，然后等待。

cues.en: So this looks to me like a big sandwich-making machine
cues.zh: 这在我看来像一台大型三明治制作机，

cues.en: but instead of sandwich, this is plastic material that's been put into this machine and then pressed together.
cues.zh: 但里面放的不是三明治，而是塑料材料，经机器压在一起。

cues.en: Yes, that's close enough.
cues.zh: 对，差不多就是这样。

cues.en: These sandwich machines can create a range of materials, from a leather-like fabric to these desk boards that are just like plywood.
cues.zh: 这些机器能制造各种材料，从仿皮织物到这种和胶合板很像的课桌板。

cues.en: They are sanded and drilled to the desk frames.
cues.zh: 这些板材经过打磨并钻孔，装到课桌框架上。

cues.en: So far, Makafui has supplied 600 desks to 12 schools around the country.
cues.zh: 到目前为止，马卡富伊已向全国12所学校提供了600张课桌。

cues.en: They cost about 60 US dollars each, but they're not paid for by the schools, but with grants and corporate donations.
cues.zh: 每张课桌约60美元，但费用不是由学校支付，而是来自拨款和企业捐赠。

cues.en: I travelled to a nearby school to see them for myself.
cues.zh: 我前往附近的一所学校，亲自看看这些课桌。

cues.en: So this is a classroom of about 60 pupils, and as I enter here I can see Makafui's desks lined up with the students sitting on them and using them.
cues.zh: 这是一间约有60名学生的教室。我进来后看到马卡富伊制作的课桌整齐排列，学生们正坐在桌前使用。

cues.en: I'm just going to go have a chat.
cues.zh: 我去和他们聊聊。

cues.en: When we are writing exams, you know, the wooden desks, they are not that smooth for the paper.
cues.zh: 考试答题时，木桌的桌面不够平滑，纸张用起来不方便。

cues.en: So when we are writing, the writing doesn't look smooth, but this one is good.
cues.zh: 所以在上面写字时，字迹不够流畅；但这张桌子很好。

cues.en: For us, it's really helpful. The wooden desks break easily.
cues.zh: 对我们来说，这真的很有帮助。木桌很容易坏。

cues.en: But these plastic desks, they don't decay and they don't break easily. They are very hard.
cues.zh: 但这些塑料课桌不会腐烂，也不容易破损。它们非常坚固。

cues.en: Well, I can't resist asking the students to test the strength of the desks.
cues.zh: 我忍不住请学生们测试一下课桌的坚固程度。

cues.en: Okay, so three, two, one, go.
cues.zh: 好，三、二、一，开始。

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 谢谢。

cues.en: Justice Baidu reporting from Accra.
cues.zh: 贾斯蒂斯·拜杜从阿克拉报道。

cues.en: Now, that's the clicking sound of a Rubik's Cube being speedily solved by a six-year-old.
cues.zh: 现在听到的是一个六岁孩子飞速还原魔方的咔嗒声。

cues.en: Lian Yunzi from China took just over 4 seconds, setting a woman's world record.
cues.zh: 来自中国的梁云曦仅用4秒多，创造了女子世界纪录。

cues.en: Her mother said Lian was first introduced to the Rubik's Cube as one of various extracurricular activities.
cues.zh: 她的母亲说，梁云曦最初是在各种课外活动中接触到魔方的。

cues.en: Alongside dance and music lessons, but how could she do it so quickly at such a young age?
cues.zh: 除了舞蹈和音乐课，她年纪这么小，怎么能还原得这么快？

cues.en: Professor Jessica Fridrich is considered one of the pioneers of what's known as speedcubing.
cues.zh: 杰茜卡·弗里德里希教授被认为是竞速魔方运动的先驱之一。

cues.en: Many cubers have adopted a method she devised for solving it.
cues.zh: 许多魔方玩家采用了她设计的还原方法。

cues.en: She gave her reaction to Lian Yunzi's record-beating time to the BBC's Rebecca Kesby.
cues.zh: 她向BBC记者丽贝卡·凯斯比谈了对梁云曦破纪录成绩的看法。

cues.en: It's absolutely mind-boggling. It's unbelievable.
cues.zh: 这实在令人难以置信，太不可思议了。

cues.en: If you look at the top six cubers, they're all from China.
cues.zh: 排名前六的魔方玩家全都来自中国。

cues.en: They are all very young, so it's a trend.
cues.zh: 他们都非常年轻，所以这已经成为一种趋势。

cues.en: And it's unbelievable that a six-year-old girl can do it in 4.27 seconds on average.
cues.zh: 一个六岁女孩平均能在4.27秒内完成，这实在难以置信。

cues.en: That is nothing short of a miracle.
cues.zh: 这简直就是奇迹。

cues.en: Basically, I mean, apparently she does spend two to three hours a day training on the Rubik's Cube.
cues.zh: 也就是说，据说她每天确实花两到三个小时练习魔方。

cues.en: Is that something that's normal for a cuber, as you call them?
cues.zh: 正如你所说，这对魔方玩家来说正常吗？

cues.en: I think she spends a lot more than that.
cues.zh: 我认为她花的时间多得多。

cues.en: Tell me why. Because you become a great speedcuber
cues.zh: 告诉我为什么。因为要成为优秀的竞速魔方玩家，

cues.en: only if you get possessed by the cube.
cues.zh: 只有对魔方着了迷才行。

cues.en: If it—if it spells the magic all over you and you can't do anything else, basically.
cues.zh: 如果它——如果魔方的魔力笼罩了你，让你基本上什么别的事都做不了。

cues.en: So I think two to three hours is an understatement.
cues.zh: 所以我认为两到三个小时还是保守说法。

cues.en: So what is your advice then? Would there be a trick to it, or a system maybe that works?
cues.zh: 那么你的建议是什么？有什么诀窍或可行的系统吗？

cues.en: There is no trick to it. It's a lot of work, an incredible
cues.zh: 没有什么诀窍。这需要大量工作和惊人的

cues.en: memorization that you have to be willing to undertake—to memorize probably over a thousand algorithms
cues.zh: 记忆力；你得愿意投入其中，记住可能超过一千种算法。

cues.en: to be able to do this fast.
cues.zh: 这样才能还原得这么快。

cues.en: It's like a magician, you know, like when you see a sleight of hand
cues.zh: 这就像魔术师，你知道，就像你看到一个手法娴熟的魔术，

cues.en: when you see a magician manipulate cards, they are doing tricks.
cues.zh: 看到魔术师操纵纸牌时，他们其实是在施展技巧。

cues.en: They are amazing. Your mind is completely blown because you have no explanation for what's happening.
cues.zh: 他们令人惊叹。你完全看傻了，因为无法解释眼前发生的一切。

cues.en: It looks natural, but it took years and years to practice.
cues.zh: 看起来很自然，但那是多年苦练的结果。

cues.en: Apparently there are cubing conventions as well as all these competitions.
cues.zh: 据说除了各种比赛，还有魔方大会。

cues.en: Has it changed much over the years?
cues.zh: 这些年来变化大吗？

cues.en: Because I mentioned this is a kind of classic 1980s toy, but it was actually invented in the seventies.
cues.zh: 我刚才提到它有点像经典的20世纪80年代玩具，但其实它发明于70年代。

cues.en: Wasn't it? It was invented in the seventies
cues.zh: 不是吗？它发明于70年代，

cues.en: and it took off right around 1980. Nineteen eighty-two
cues.zh: 并在1980年前后流行起来。1982年，

cues.en: was the first world championship in Rubik's Cube in Budapest.
cues.zh: 首届魔方世界锦标赛在布达佩斯举行。

cues.en: In Europe, I was representing Czechoslovakia at that time.
cues.zh: 当时我代表捷克斯洛伐克参赛。

cues.en: The cube is completely different nowadays.
cues.zh: 如今的魔方完全不同了。

cues.en: They are made in a way that allows a certain type of twisting the cube.
cues.zh: 现在的魔方设计允许以特定方式扭转方块。

cues.en: Certain type of handling that you would not be able to do back in the 1980s or 1970s
cues.zh: 还有一些在20世纪80年代或70年代无法做到的操作方式，

cues.en: because those cubes were hard to turn.
cues.zh: 因为那时的魔方很难转动。

cues.en: The difference between a speedcuber today and back in the 1970s, eighties, let's say,
cues.zh: 比如说，今天的竞速魔方玩家与70、80年代相比，

cues.en: is that there was no internet at that time
cues.zh: 区别在于当时还没有互联网，

cues.en: and every cuber had to also invent their own system, or their own version of a system
cues.zh: 每个玩家还必须发明自己的系统，或自己的一套方法，

cues.en: to solve and to be fast.
cues.zh: 才能还原魔方并达到速度。

cues.en: Professor Jessica Fridrich.
cues.zh: 杰茜卡·弗里德里希教授。

cues.en: And that's all from us for now.
cues.zh: 以上就是本期节目的全部内容。

cues.en: If you want to get in touch, you can email us at globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk.
cues.zh: 如果你想联系我们，可以发送邮件至globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk。

cues.en: You can also find us on X at BBC World Service.
cues.zh: 你也可以在X上关注BBC World Service。

cues.en: Use the hashtag Global News Pod.
cues.zh: 请使用话题标签Global News Pod。

cues.en: And don't forget our sibling podcast, The Global Story, which goes in depth and beyond the headlines
cues.zh: 别忘了我们的兄弟播客《全球故事》，它会深入讲述一条新闻，超越头条。

cues.en: on one big story.
cues.zh: 每期聚焦一个重大故事。

cues.en: This edition of the Global News Podcast was mixed by Chris Ablakwa and the producer was
cues.zh: 本期《全球新闻播客》由克里斯·阿布拉夸混音，制片人是

cues.en: Marion Strawn. The editor is Karen Martin.
cues.zh: 马里恩·斯特朗，编辑是凯伦·马丁。

cues.en: I'm Alex Ritson. Until next time, goodbye.
cues.zh: 我是亚历克斯·里特森。下次再会。
